_comment: run_21: a SINGLE HABITAT FIELD. manifold_prior.fixed_coupling = 1 makes every rate read the same field H = (Z - z_occ).f with its own positive sensitivity w_scale_j (no private parts): good habitat is good for all four rates, no trade-offs. Parsimony test: run_19/19e/20a/20b all bought fit by pulling the fields apart (rho 0.85->0.56, 0.6->0.03) and building a 25-40% Allee-dead belt on the northern Plains; with lambda and K monotone in one field, that belt can only occupy a narrow band of H.

habitat_centering = occupied: fields centred at the mean Z of occupied cell-years, so each intercept is the rate at typical occupied habitat and alpha_k's prior is a prior on K's level where birds live (the uncentered features' near-constant direction otherwise acts as a free second intercept: run_19's K level drifted to 0.03 route counts).
Capacity level prior loosened to median 3.0 route counts, alpha_k_scale 1.0 (about a factor e per sd), softplus link kept. Otherwise run_19: no dispersal noise, survival amplitude scale 1.0263.
